Description

The Bambu Lab H2C is a high-performance, multi-nozzle production system designed to deliver complex, multi-material prints with industrial precision and virtually zero filament waste.

While previous multi-material systems relied on wasteful purging to clear the nozzle between swaps, the H2C introduces the Vortek™ Hotend Change System. This isn't just a 3D printer; it’s a tool-swapping ecosystem that physically exchanges hotends in seconds. It allows you to combine vastly different materials—like rigid Carbon Fibre for structure and PVA for support structure - within a single print, without the cross-contamination or massive waste towers that typically plague multi-material workflows.

Beyond its material swapping, the H2C is an engineering filament's dream. With a 65°C actively heated chamber and 350°C all-metal hotends, it is purpose-built for the most challenging engineering filaments. Whether you are in a cold workshop in Hobart or a humid studio in Brisbane, the H2C provides a stable, industrial-grade environment that ensures large-scale ABS, Polycarbonate, or Nylon parts print without warping or delamination.

Key Features

65°C Actively Heated Chamber

Provides a temperature-controlled environment for large-scale engineering prints, preventing warping and ensuring perfect layer adhesion for high-temp materials like ABS and PC.

Vortek™ Hotend Change System

Swaps between up to 6 induction-heated hotends in seconds, virtually eliminating filament waste and reducing material waste by up to 95% compared to traditional AMS systems.

8-Second Induction Heating

Rapidly brings the active hotend to temperature, slashing the transition time between materials and making high-speed multi-material printing actually viable for production.

Full Filament Path AI Diagnostics

Utilises 59 onboard sensors and a quad-camera system to monitor every millimetre of filament from the spool to the nozzle, catching "spaghetti" or air-printing before it ruins your job.

AMS 2 Pro with Active 65°C Drying

Continuously dehumidifies and dries your filament during the print, ensuring engineering-grade materials like Nylon and PC remain moisture-free for flawless layer adhesion.

Technical Specifications

H2C AMS Combo Specifications
Build Volume 330 x 320 x 325 mm
Motion System CoreXY with Active Vibration Compensation
Hotend System Vortek hotend change system, houses up to 6 hotends
Hotend Heating and Swap Induction heating, hotend exchange
Max Nozzle Temperature 350 C
Chamber Temperature 65 °C active heating
Filament Support PLA, PETG, TPU, ABS, ASA, PC, PA, carbon or glass fibre composites
AI and Sensing 59 integrated sensors and quad-camera vision with automated offset calibration and real-time error detection
Air Filtration 3 stage: G3 pre-filter, H12 HEPA, coconut shell activated carbon
Connectivity Wi-Fi, Ethernet, offline mode for security or LAN only
Enclosure and Safety Fully enclosed, flame-retardant construction with industrial-grade filtration
Multi-Material Workflow Includes an AMS unit supporting up to 4 colours as standard, expandable
Key Benefits Up to 95% purge waste reduction, no material cross-contamination, sub-50 micron accuracy with automated calibration
